name: A Long Walk 🪓
desc:
You were looking at your phone and walked right off a cliff. Now the only way out is a road through the wild.

Grab up to 3 friends and survive the walk.

🌲 Start in the forest and find out what lies beyond it
🪓 Chop, mine and craft your own tools and weapons
🐺 Hunt animals and cook their meat to stay alive
🏕️ Rest in villages and store what you gather
🌙 Survive the night
🏁 Make it to 100 km... if you can

Can you make it to the end of the road?

👍 Like the game and join the group for updates!

llm.loop: walk a long road through the wild with up to 3 friends -> chop, mine and craft tools and weapons -> hunt and cook -> rest in villages -> survive nights -> reach 100 km
llm.instructions: survive the walk; chop, mine, craft, hunt, cook, rest, survive the night
unique: a long-walk journey survival (in the vein of A Dusty Trip)
llm.thumbnails: cartoon friends following a map on a dirt road; wolves at night
llm.complexity_notes: crafting, survival stats, long procedural road
